metadata.title: Secure Identity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Institutional identity trust posture asserting that identities are safe to rely upon for access, accountability, and governance.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Digital Identity trust domain encompassing all identity capabilities.

props.name: architecture-pattern

props.name: data-entity

metadata.remarks:
Secure Identity is a composite trust assertion expressing the institutional position that identities are authoritative, correctly authenticated, properly authorized, lifecycle‑managed, auditable, assurance‑rated, and bound to appropriate contexts. Secure Identity introduces no independent controls; it aggregates and asserts trust across constituent identity patterns.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern serves as the enterprise identity trust statement used by SSPPs, architecture reviews, and assurance activities. A system may assert Secure Identity only when all referenced identity patterns are satisfied or explicitly compensated.
